channel.title: IndieHOT — Indie Game Hot Topics
channel.description: IndieHOT collects indie game news from a set of public sources every day and scores it by rules: engines & tools, publishing & marketing, devlogs, industry & funding, events, reviews & postmortems. Only titles, one-line self-written summaries and outbound links are shown — no full text is republished.

item.title: Flutter Flame Tutorial: Build Your First 2D Game (Beginner Guide)
item.description: If you already know Flutter, you're closer to shipping your first game than you think — this beginner guide walks you through building a 2D game with the Flame engine.

item.title: This Tool Brings 2D Painting Workflows Into Unreal Engine 5
item.description: Inky recreates traditional painting materials inside Unreal Engine 5, letting artists paint 3D assets with a 2D workflow.

item.title: Sensor Tower introduces web store revenue estimates
item.description: Sensor Tower now estimates direct-to-consumer web store revenue, giving developers a fuller picture of app and game monetisation beyond the stores.

item.title: October 2026 mobile game charts: Top Lords takes off, Tencent falls 11% and AI listens in
item.description: AppMagic's October charts show Top Lords taking off, Tencent down 11%, and AI listening in as the month's big talking points.

item.title: Learn the Art of Making AAA Game-Ready Characters Using Industry-Standard Tools
item.description: This Wingfox master class walks through the complete workflow of creating game-ready characters, aimed at artists who want to reach AAA quality.

item.title: Dev snapshot: Godot 4.8 beta 5
item.description: Within a week of beta 4, the Godot team has fixed every remaining launch-blocking issue and is putting out one final snapshot before the release candidate, so developers can try this build and help catch the last bugs before the official release.

item.title: Sony's delight: 40% of PS5 players flocked to GTA 6, 39 million entered the city, and 70% of new console owners played it first
item.description: Sony shared early platform figures for GTA 6: 40% of PS5 players jumped in, 39 million entered the city, and 70% of new console owners made it their first game.

item.title: Same daily puzzle for everyone, no server: notes from building 7 offline puzzles in React Native
item.description: Solo developer Thanh shares how he built seven offline daily puzzles in React Native so everyone worldwide gets the same puzzle each day, with no server involved.

item.title: Shipping a Game in Japanese: Text Wrapping, Placeholders, Pronouns and What to Leave in English
item.description: Japan is a high-spending but demanding market for games; this hands-on guide covers where Japanese localization most often breaks — text wrapping, placeholders, pronouns — and what should stay in English.

item.title: 12 Days, One Million Copies: 'The Worst Class I Ever Taught' Becomes This Year's Fourth Million-Selling Chinese Indie Game
item.description: Funcore Games' 'The Worst Class I Ever Taught' sold over a million copies in just 12 days, becoming this year's fourth Chinese indie game to reach that milestone — a case study in topic choice and launch pacing for small teams.

item.title: Preventing World-Partition Disasters in Unreal Engine 5 with a 3-Stage Python Dry->Canary->Apply Pipeline & 3D Spline Clearance Auditor
item.description: After a bad batch edit on a large alpine railway map, the author standardized a three-stage safe-mutation pipeline — dry run, canary, then apply — paired with reversible JSON backups and a spline clearance audit, so large-scale UE5 World Partition edits no longer risk wrecking a thousand actors in one pass.

item.title: Sony's Disc-Less Future Looks Inevitable When Only Seven Games Hit 100K Physical Sales
item.description: Circana data shows only seven PlayStation games have sold more than 100,000 physical copies in the US this year, so the retail channel is shrinking faster than many expected — a data point worth weighing for indies considering a physical release.

item.title: How we slashed LLM Token cost by 90% with Markov States, Aho-Corasick & CoALA
item.description: A state-machine approach to taming the ballooning token costs of long-running AI writing and RPG tools.

item.title: A Unity Performance Pass for Mid-Range Phones: An Eight-Point Review
item.description: A Unity performance checklist for mid-range phones — eight checkpoints to keep frame rates and retention steady on older devices.

item.title: Why Japanese text turns into tofu boxes only in packaged Unreal Engine 5 builds
item.description: Japanese text that renders fine in the editor turns into tofu boxes in packaged UE5 builds — a solo dev in Japan traces the font issue to its root.

item.title: Why Xiaomi's Concept Supercar Seeks Realism in Games
item.description: An interview with Xiaomi's car design chief on how its concept supercar chases realism inside Gran Turismo 7's Vision GT programme, a useful reference for developers working on vehicles and brand crossovers.

item.title: Writing a Game Art Style Guide That Outsourced Artists Will Actually Follow
item.description: Most art style guides fail quietly because they don't answer an outsourced artist's real questions mid-task; this post shows how to structure one so it actually gets followed and kept alive.

item.title: Epic Games to drop Blueprints from Unreal Engine 6 as AI reshapes migration plans
item.description: Epic confirmed Unreal Engine 6 will drop Blueprints visual scripting and the Actor Gameplay Framework, with AI slated to help developers migrate to replacements.

item.title: Our tiny games site earned its first 7 cents
item.description: Two weeks after launching Pop Recall, a collection of tiny vanilla-JavaScript browser games, the author earned the site's first 7 cents and shares the honest ledger behind it.

item.title: Creating Game-Ready Fictional Military Vehicle In 3D
item.description: The artist walks through the workflow behind the original XM-118 Onza 8x8 fire support vehicle, from detailed interiors and a detachable turret to a fully drivable Unreal Engine setup.
